Extreme operational duration: continuous duty >= 16h with weekly workload > 65h

evidenceStrength.summary: Robust multi-source evidence with active continuous wearable biometric telemetry and verified operational logs.
evidenceDetails: Authorized duty schedule verified
Operational workload logged
Rest and recovery data documented
Self-check questionnaire provided
Continuous wearable biometric telemetry synchronized

reviewTriggers: Critical composite welfare risk score (90.1%) exceeds acute safety threshold
Severe cumulative duty exposure: graveyard duty >= 16h with acute sleep deficit < 5h
Extreme operational duration: continuous duty >= 16h with weekly workload > 65h
Physical Fatigue & Strain: 88.0/100 (HIGH strain vs baseline 28.1)
Rest & Sleep Recovery: 4.0hrs/day (HIGH strain vs baseline 6.8)
Heart Rate Variability (HRV): 16.0ms (HIGH strain vs baseline 59.8)
humanWelfareReview.recommendedOfficerAction: URGENT WELFARE INTERVENTION: Initiate confidential 1-on-1 check-in within 12 hours. Review active duty roster for immediate 24-hour mandatory rest rotation and evaluate medical/counseling referral.
humanWelfareReview.assignedRole: Unit Welfare Officer / Station Resilience Lead
